_comment: length —— 3 英文边界 / 4 现有中文义项，**四条中文义项与三条英文边界一对一，没有任何合并或舍弃**。这是最干净的样本：raw=0 空间长度、raw=1 时间长度、raw=2 物体的延伸段。

_oldSenses.reason: 对应英文 raw=0 the linear extent in space from one end to the other; the extent of a line or plane。
与「长度」同指 raw=0，中文可互换。
对应英文 raw=1 the property of being the extent of something from beginning to end in time —— **时间上的长度**。
对应英文 raw=2 a section of something that is long and narrow —— 细长的一段。

senses.note: the linear extent in space from one end to the other。**空间维度的长度**。线索：the length of the room / a 2-metre length。
the property of being the extent of something from beginning to end in time。**时间维度的长度**。线索：the length of the meeting / the length of time。与 s1 分界：量的是空间还是时间。
a section of something that is long and narrow。指**物体本身**。线索：a length of rope / lengths of silk。
